subject: wizardBookshelf
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: wizard's bookshelf with tomes, scrolls, orbs and candles.
Style: high-fantasy anime.
reasoning:
I'm designing a wizard's bookshelf scene as a single module—a tall wooden shelf with four tiers holding colorful books, scrolls, glowing orbs, candles with flames, a crescent-moon carving, and maybe an hourglass or skull, aiming for a moderate-length, efficient build using the part/joint API.

Working out the shelf frame dimensions, crown gable with a glowing moon, and plinth feet, then planning how to populate each shelf with varied books by merging geometry per color and layering cover, page, and gold-band details on each spine...

I'm deciding to skip the fiddly page-block detail for upright books and instead reserve it for a few lying books where the pages are visible from the side. Then I move on to planning other shelf props: orbs on lathe stands, candles with wax and glow flames, and scroll stacks with ribboned ends.

I'm also sketching in an hourglass, a potion bottle, a glowing rune plaque, and floating sparkle octahedrons, then setting up a helper function to place each glowing colored object with position, rotation, scale, and glow strength -- making sure all geometries share consistent attributes so they can merge cleanly, including the wood materials painted with a grain texture.

Now I'm picking an anime-inspired palette of bright purples, teals, and roses against deep plum-brown wood, then laying out the shelf's vertical positions and interior dimensions before planning how books and props fill each shelf level from left to right.

Shelf3 gets candles on both sides, and the top of the shelf gets a crown gable, moon, and a wizard hat made from a leaning cone lathe with a gold band and star. For the helper functions, I'm setting up Euler rotations in degrees, a merged glow effect for flames, candle geometry with wax cylinders and conical flames plus wax drips, and orb components with a glowing sphere, small gold lathe stand, and a brighter inner core.

Now I'm adding a gold halo ring torus around the orb, placing a rune plaque on the crown gable using an extruded outline shape, and positioning a moon SVG plane on the gable facing forward with a glow effect. I'm also defining a scroll helper using a rotated cylinder with ribbon torus end caps, then finalizing all this geometry.
